source.title: Calendar (New Style) Act 1750 (24 Geo. 2 c. 23)
source.author: Parliament of Great Britain
source.gives: The last old-style day in England (2 September 1752), Gregorian from 14 September 1752, 1 January 1752 as the year's first day (S7, S11, S12, S13)
